Select activity rows for human Pim-1 kinase where standard_type is IC50. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, assays on assay_id, target_dictionary on tid, docs on doc_id, and compound_records on record_id. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical_smiles. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
